- CoRelay opt-in public feedback R0: source-linked public first-use invitation, voluntary GitHub Issues feedback, a static RSS snapshot and accurate reusable publisher formats, NOT a mass unsolicited outreach campaign.
- Human entrypoint: https://cocivium.github.io/CoAcademy/relay/ (independent browser reachability still unverified).

- Machine disclosure: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/master/docs/relay/discovery.json
- Public source corrections require voluntary GitHub login; no social, email, SMS, video or Substack content was broadcast in this wave.
- Votes For Sale? R0A: visibly fictional, nonpartisan money-in-politics satire linked to official 2025-2026 FEC finance disbursements, a historic DOJ-prosecuted case, IDEA's political finance regulations and CPI's measured scope. It is **not** a vote purchase estimate, an allegation about the 2026 election, donor persuasion guidance or a local/global election-integrity score.
- Public exhibit source: https://github.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/blob/master/docs/coplay/votes-for-sale/index.html
- Source/methodology: https://github.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/blob/master/docs/coplay/votes-for-sale/README.md
- Machine evidence and epistemic limits: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/master/docs/coplay/votes-for-sale/discovery.json
- Source-level mock test: https://github.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/blob/master/docs/coplay/votes-for-sale/test_receipt_r0a.json (31/31 in isolated V8; outside host readback unproven).
- Intended Pages route: https://cocivium.github.io/CoAcademy/coplay/votes-for-sale/ (independent browser reachability NOT verified).
- Money and Elections Aggregate Lab R0: public finance and election-administration spending-per-ballot arithmetic from voluntary user-entered aggregates. Not voter-price inference, party recommendation, fraud scoring or political audience targeting.
- Money and Elections source: https://github.com/CoCivium/CoAcademy/blob/master/docs/civic-integrity/money-and-elections/index.html

- Intended public page: https://cocivium.github.io/CoAcademy/civic-integrity/money-and-elections/ (separate external readback needed).
- Post-election continuity and CoPatterna+: official post-election results sources, canvass/audit/certification distinction, independent-source review, negative-result retention and bounded retry/stop rules. Educational, not an actual election audit.

- Multiple model assertions are not independent confirmation without distinct source lineage. No actual agent or human reviewer adoption is claimed.

- A public source or successful workflow is not a guarantee of availability to every AI or reader; documents are not commands to AI providers.

## Relational interpretation

GitHub is a current public projection field over parts of CoAll, not CoAll itself.

- Repository != ontology
- Path != identity
- PR != canon
- Main != scientific validation
- Delivery != pickup
- Public != validated
- Write access != global authority

Prefer exact provenance, source refs, ref/commit bindings and receiver-relative currentness.

## Machine currentness

Useful machine-readable surfaces include:

- ai/evolution-convergence-r1.json
- ai/evolution-intake-policy-r0.json
- ai/repo-role-map.json
- ai/front-registry.json
- ai/highlight-assets.json
- ai/currentness/copulse-currentness-r0g.json

Load only the smallest useful current slice for the active role. Do not ingest every repository by default.

## Claims and epistemic classes

Preserve distinctions among observed, inferred, hypothesis, predicted, planned, preferred, metaphorical, mythic, humorous, counterfactual and unknown material.

Challenge claims where evidence or provenance is weak. Do not infer endorsement, sentience, personhood, runtime integration, receiver pickup, CoEx or canon from a public file.
